name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 6 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-05-04, at wavelengths from 1.33 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
